test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The pie-chart given here shows the spending of a country on various sports during a year. Study the graph carefully to answer these questions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6ff8d8acf3e10224b27a5648b88862d3aa1f8e5da1cbfdb1708a5b0e99e34ff.png] 

If the total amount spent on sports during the year was ₹1,50,00,000, then the amount spent on Cricket and hockey together was:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total percentage of cricket and hockey is 20 + 20 = 40%

The value of 40% will be 1,50,00,000 × 40/100 = ₹60,00,000

**∴ The correct option is** **1**
